$comment: CC BY 4.0 (see REUSE.toml). ADR 0003 floor-shortfall options as players see them. Working labels (maintainer decision 2026-10-07), to be tested in the paper pilot (§9.3). The rule column is the engine's floorScaling key; whatever_works applies the proportional cut.

options.label: Same share of the minimum
options.explain: Every farm gets the same fraction of its minimum.

options.label: Protect the smallest minimums
options.explain: Small farms keep their minimum; the largest absorbs the cut.

options.label: Everyone gives up the same
options.explain: Each farm loses the same amount of water.

options.label: Half-claims first (Talmud)
options.explain: An old rule that splits the shortfall in a balanced way between large and small.

options.label: Per person
options.explain: The cut follows how many people each farm supports.

options.label: Whatever works
options.explain: No preference: a proportional cut is applied.
